name: showcase
description: Shapes close to real CFD problems (pipes, ducts, a bluff body) with named inlet/outlet patches, from make_synthetic.py (run it first). They mesh cleanly and serve as worked examples.

cases.name: pipe_elbow
cases.note: 90 deg pipe bend, bend radius 1.5 D

cases.name: helical_coil
cases.note: 2.5-turn helical tube (coil heat exchanger); at baseCellSize 0.025 and 0.0275 one face has skewness > 4

cases.name: venturi
cases.note: venturi tube: cosine contraction to a 0.4 D throat, 7 deg diffuser

cases.name: orifice_pipe
cases.note: sharp-edged orifice plate (beta 0.5) in a pipe

cases.name: backward_step
cases.note: backward-facing step, expansion ratio 2, symmetry side planes

cases.name: t_junction
cases.note: square-duct T-junction (mixing tee), branch half as wide

cases.name: pin_fins
cases.note: staggered bank of 13 pins across a duct (pin-fin heat sink / tube bank)

cases.name: body_in_tunnel
cases.note: bluff body with a rounded nose and a 25 deg rear slant in a wind tunnel (external flow)
